question: 在售商品平均售价高于全平台商品平均售价的商品分类有哪些？（请给出分类名称与平均售价，取前5名）
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, ROUND(AVG(p.price), 2) AS avg_price FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE p.status = 'on_sale' GROUP BY c.id, c.name HAVING AVG(p.price) > (SELECT AVG(price) FROM products) ORDER BY avg_price DESC, c.name LIMIT 5
